research_question: Is Iceland achieving a soft landing — bringing CPI inflation down toward the Central Bank's 2.5% target while preserving growth, employment, and króna stability?

gdp.name: Real GDP Growth
gdp.transformation: YoY % = (RealGDP_t / RealGDP_{t-4} - 1) * 100; QoQ SA % = seasonally adjusted quarter-on-quarter chain-volume growth.

cpi.name: Consumer Price Index (CPI) & Inflation
cpi.units: % YoY and Index (May 1988 = 100; also shown rebased 2015M01 = 100)
cpi.transformation: 12-month inflation computed as (CPI_t / CPI_{t-12} - 1) * 100 and cross-checked against Statistics Iceland published annual change; rebased index = (CPI_t / CPI_2015M01) * 100. CBI inflation target = 2.5%.

policy_rate.name: CBI Policy Interest Rate (7-Day Term Deposit Rate)
policy_rate.source: Central Bank of Iceland (Seðlabanki Íslands), TimeSeriesID=75 (matches Key Policy Rate ID=17923)
policy_rate.frequency: Policy meeting / Daily effective step series
policy_rate.transformation: Unadjusted nominal policy rate (7-day term deposit rate, CBI's key stance rate since May 2014). Step-line reflects effective dates.

exchange_rate.name: Exchange Rate (ISK per 1 USD & 1 EUR)
exchange_rate.source: Central Bank of Iceland (Seðlabanki Íslands), Official Mid-Rate TimeSeriesID=4055 (USD) & 4064 (EUR)
exchange_rate.units: ISK per 1 USD (and ISK per 1 EUR)
exchange_rate.transformation: Direct quotation (price notation: ISK per 1 unit of foreign currency). Rising ISK/USD indicates Icelandic króna depreciation; falling ISK/USD indicates króna appreciation. Includes 30-business-day moving average.

trade_balance.name: Merchandise Trade Balance (Goods Exports & Imports)
trade_balance.units: ISK millions (Exports FOB, Imports CIF, Trade Balance = FOB - CIF)
trade_balance.transformation: Monthly merchandise balance (Exports FOB minus Imports CIF) plus 12-month rolling cumulative trade balance.

unemployment.name: Unemployment Rate (Labor Force Survey, Ages 16–74)
unemployment.source: Statistics Iceland (Hagstofa Íslands), Tables VIN00002 (SA) & VIN00001 (Original)
unemployment.transformation: Seasonally adjusted headline monthly unemployment rate (total, ages 16–74) plotted alongside unadjusted original survey rate.
